title: Invitation
check-code.body: Copy the complete invitation link again or ask for a new invitation.
intro.title: You are invited to agent.dfx.swiss
intro.platform: This invitation creates your account and your private organization.
name.label: Your display name
name.hint: Shown to the people you work with (1–80 characters).
name.invalid: Enter a display name of 1 to 80 characters.
create.explain: Your device will ask you to create a passkey.
cancelled: Passkey creation was cancelled – try again.
unlock.title: Confirm once more
unlock.explain: Confirm once more to sign in. This unlocks your encryption keys on this device.
org.title: Organization invitation
org.unavailable: Organization invitations can be accepted in a later version of this page.
recovery.title: Your recovery code
recovery.explain: This code unlocks your account if you lose your passkeys. It is shown only once. Store it in a safe place.
recovery.copy-failed: Copying failed – select the code and copy it manually.
recovery.confirm.label: Type the last group of the code ({length} characters) to confirm
recovery.confirm.mismatch: This does not match the last group of your code.
recovery.skip.title: Skip the recovery code?
recovery.skip.body: If you lose all your passkeys and do not have this code, your account cannot be restored. Your private organization has only you as a member: all its data would be lost.
unlock.other-account: This passkey belongs to another account. Choose the passkey you just created.
